title: Slushie Bar Salts Gummy Bear 10ml E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Salts' Gummy Bear is a nostalgic and fun-filled e-liquid that perfectly captures the essence of everyone's favourite chewy fruity candy. This flavour offers a delightful mix of candied fruit notes, creating a rainbow of tastes that mimic the irresistible charm of those beloved gummy bear sweets. Each draw delivers a burst of mixed fruit flavours, reminiscent of digging into a bag of these iconic sweets, with every puff providing a different fruity note. The e-liquid brings together a medley of sweet and subtly tangy fruit flavours, all wrapped up in a sugary gummy candy base. It's a playful, joyous vape experience that appeals to those with a sweet tooth, as well as vapers who enjoy vibrant and dynamic fruit profiles with a guilt-free sugary base. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
